config_fingerprint.qk_norm_note: Qwen3 applies per-head RMSNorm on Q and K before RoPE; not a separate HF config flag.

weight_snapshot.source: HF LFS x-linked-etag at the pinned revision; each value is the shard content SHA-256

chain_semantics.clip_interval_note: Pinned for clipfrac0; must match C1 chain_logprob_aggregates.default_clip_interval unless an explicit contract revision changes both.
chain_semantics.singleton_aggregate_note: singleton_aggregate is a C2 execution/aggregation mode only. It must never populate comparison_lhs_role or comparison_rhs_role.
chain_semantics.tf32_note: WS1 TF32 enable/disable is owned by the C1 contract; C2 gates must not introduce a private TF32 policy.

report_naming.note: C2 freezes naming rules; C3+ emit reports that must obey these roles.

backend_actual_semantics.note: C2 executes every representative case and records runtime-observed actual backend/kernel provenance. Later children own full-model dispatch provenance.

primary_matrix.description: Fixed #150 Batch × Chunked-Prefill matrix prerequisite workload cells.

batch_permutation.note: Permutation exercises layout invariance; logical compare restores sample_id order.

chunk.note: Longest primary seq_len=19 with chunk_size=7 yields chunks [7,7,5].

short_full_model_fixture.note: Shorter sequence on full architecture+weights only; never shrinks layers/hidden/heads/vocab.

long_full_model_fixture.note: Long fixed sequence on the same full architecture and pinned weight snapshot.

representative_full_model_fixture.note: Primary variable-length matrix fixture; full architecture+weights.

gradient_singleton_aggregate.definition: N independent B=1 runs of the same N logical samples, aggregated with fixed sample order and active-token denominator
gradient_singleton_aggregate.compare_to: single B=N run of the same logical sample/token multiset

packing.detail: NativePackOp is present; C2 pins and round-trips the packed variable-length fixture even though packing is outside the primary 2x2 matrix.

qk_norm.detail: Qwen3-8B Dense applies QK-Norm before RoPE on every layer.
